en.t: The older sister untied her wide sash.
She did not avoid him at all.

units.source_text: 她没系窄腰带，松开了衣裳的下摆，

en.t: She had not tied a narrow waist cord, and loosened the hem of her clothes,

units.source_text: 一只手抓住窗框，另一只手把袜子脱掉，然后钻进左侧的睡铺。

en.t: with one hand holding the window frame, she took off her socks with the other hand and then slipped into the bed on the left.

units.source_text: 她当然不会钻到他的睡铺里。

en.t: Of course, she would not slip into his bed.
